in_marathi.name: Rabindranath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gentle One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rabindranath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is gentle, tender, and kind to all living beings. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rabh' (gentle) and 'Indra' (lord) or 'Nath' (lord, master) and is associated with the god Indra, the king of heaven, who is known for his gentle demeanor and kindness.
